evidence_plan.requirement: What type of model is KAR?

payload.reason: The evidence clearly identifies KAR as an end-to-end MRC model that utilizes general knowledge to enhance its performance.

claims.text: KAR is an end-to-end MRC model that uses general knowledge to assist its attention mechanisms.
KAR is designed to be robust to noise and performs comparably to state-of-the-art MRC models.
